verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching data movement is a doc titled "How to Mount Datasets in a Gradient Notebook" and the claim that Machines come with free unlimited bandwidth. Shared drives are internal private-network storage, not an import/export path, so they don't count. A hands-on report says Core servers had very slow internet and copying datasets took forever, which undercuts the 'efficiently' part. missing for 10: S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync integrations, documented transfer tooling (e.g., CLI upload/download), details of how datasets are ingested, independent confirmation of efficient transfers.
